zh: 一句古老的亚洲谚语 tongsang imong（同床异梦）——同床者睡在同一张床上，却做着不同的梦——为本书的探索提供了一个比喻：殖民主义与民族主义栖居同一空间，却设想两个不同的梦境世界。后殖民批评家把殖民主义与民族主义描绘为同床者而非敌人：被殖民地的精英采用西方的模块化民族形式，把它当作建构自己民族的模板。这种派生的民族观念被认为即使在摆脱殖民统治获得解放之后，仍在身份与文化层面延续殖民状况。对后殖民批评家而言，床是现代民族的基础，而同床者的梦之间的差异，仅如复制品与原件之间的差异。
en: An old Asian saying, tongsang imong—bedfellows sleep in the same bed but have different dreams—provides a trope for this book’s exploration of the ways in which colonialism and nationalism inhabit the same space yet envisage two different dream worlds. Postcolonial critics depict colonialism and nationalism as bedfellows, not enemies, with colonized elites embracing the Western modular form of the nation as the template for their own. The derivative idea of nation is seen to perpetuate the colonial condition in terms of their identities and cultures even after liberation from colonial rule. For postcolonial critics, the bed is the foundation of the modern nation, and the dreams of the bedfellows differ only to the extent that copies differ from the original.

zh: 在我的研究中，殖民主义与民族主义的关系不止于军事与政治上的对立，或原件与复制品的同构。共用的床具有一种时间性的物质性，它使同床者得以共眠，却也给他们的梦下了一个永远无法实现的诅咒。资本主义就是这张床。它把殖民者和民族主义者拉到一起，为共同目标——给定领土的资本主义发展——而努力，但出于不同理由。殖民者渴望一种能惠及整个帝国的资本主义发展形式，民族主义者则渴望发展自己的国民经济。但他们的梦永远转瞬即逝，并且成为噩梦——不仅对于剩余价值被其“代表者”攫取的人民如此，对做梦者自身也是如此。这些同床者既不能控制资本主义扩张的速度，也不能完全化解它催生的社会危机。“同床异梦”的比喻提示：要充分说明殖民政治与民族政治这两者之间的关系，对其分析必须纳入全球资本主义。
en: In my study, the relationship between colonialism and nationalism involves more than their military and political opposition or the homology of original and copies. The shared bed has a temporal materiality that enables the bedfellows to sleep together but taints their dreams with the curse of making them unattainable. Capitalism is the bed. It draws together colonialists and their nationalist counterparts to work for a common goal—capitalist development of a given territory—but for different reasons. While colonialists desire a form of capitalist development that can benefit the entire empire, nationalists aspire to develop a national economy of their own. But their dreams are forever fleeting, and they become nightmares not just for the people whose surplus values are appropriated by those who represent them but also for the dreamers themselves. These bedfellows can neither control the speed of capitalist expansion nor fully resolve the social crises spawned by it. The trope of two dreams in one bed suggests that an analysis of colonial and national politics warrants the incorporation of global capitalism if we are to adequately account for their dyadic relationship.

zh: 民族梦想与殖民梦想
en: national and colonial dreams

zh: 民族主义参与殖民霸权的建构，尤其体现在殖民权力与民族主义权力合作又争夺、从而嵌入日常生活劳动与交换社会关系的方式之中。弗朗茨·法农（Frantz Fanon）敏锐地观察到殖民权力在日常生活中的运作。他认为，被殖民者若要摆脱即使在形式解放之后仍延续的殖民统治形式，民族斗争和反殖民斗争必须伴有社会意识。在他看来，民族主义若不容纳针对社会不平等真正根源的可行社会计划，就不过是一具空壳。民族主义“如果不通过迅速转化为对社会和政治需要的意识、换言之转化为人道主义而得到丰富和深化，它就会走进死胡同。不发达国家的资产阶级领袖把民族意识囚禁在贫瘠的形式主义之中……民族的有生命力的表现是整个人民不断发展的意识。”
如果社会意识先于这种“真正的”民族主义，对社会正义的激烈要求就会沦为只服务民族精英的节庆式部落主义。此外，真正的民族与社会意识必须建立在批判资本主义不平衡发展之上——在其中民族与殖民资产阶级剥削边缘地带的人民。
这条解放之路仍是一纸乌托邦人道主义处方。

children: 〔校注〕原文此句作“If social consciousness precedes this ‘authentic’ nationalism…”（若社会意识先于这种“真正的”民族主义，对社会正义的激烈要求便沦为节庆式部落主义），与前文法农“民族主义须迅速转化为社会意识”的论述方向似相反，疑为原书表述倒置；照印翻译，存疑。

en: Nationalism participates in the construction of colonial hegemony, especially in the ways in which colonial power, in cooperation and contention with nationalist power, embeds itself in social relations of work and exchange in everyday life. Frantz Fanon astutely observed the operation of colonial power in everyday life. He believed that social consciousness must accompany the national and anticolonial struggle if the colonized are to free themselves from forms of colonial rule that endure even after formal liberation. In his view, if nationalism does not accommodate viable social programs that address the true source of social inequality, it is nothing but an empty shell. If nationalism “is not enriched and deepened by a very rapid transformation into a consciousness of social and political needs, in other words into humanism, it leads up a blind alley. The bourgeois leaders of underdeveloped countries imprison national consciousness in sterile formalism. . . . The living expression of the nation is the moving consciousness of the whole of the people.”

If social consciousness precedes this “authentic” nationalism, fierce demands for social justice turn into a festive tribalism that serves only national elites. Furthermore, an authentic national and social consciousness must rest on the critique of the uneven development of capitalism in which national and colonial bourgeoisies exploit peoples on the periphery.
This path to liberation remains a utopian humanist prescription.

zh: 在本研究中，我把解放的人道主义预言转置为日常社会生活中殖民支配的问题式。如果说在法农的人道主义解放处方中，民族的、社会的与国际的意识形式内在地捆绑在一起，那么它们也可以被理解为在殖民统治的巩固中同样彼此嵌合。因此，我的工作阐述民族主义在殖民建构社会生活中所扮演的角色。在把民族主义作为支配工具的批判中，法农区分真正的与“狭隘的”形式。狭隘民族主义服务民族资产阶级——它充当殖民资产阶级的中间人，声称代表人民的普遍权利，却只以此作为增进自身利益的手段。他的著作没有阐述民族主义影响日常生活的具体方式，因为边缘地带的日常生活如此深地缠结于殖民统治，以致只有彻底的断裂——暴力——似乎才能触发真正民族意识的发展。
en: In this study, I transpose the humanist prophecy for liberation into a problematic of colonial domination in everyday social life. If forms of national, social, and international consciousness are intrinsically bound together in Fanon’s humanist prescription for liberation, they can also be understood as having an equally embedded relationship in the consolidation of colonial rule. Thus, my work elaborates the role played by nationalism in the colonial construction of social life. In his critique of nationalism as a tool of domination, Fanon distinguishes authentic from “narrow” forms. Narrow nationalism serves the national bourgeoisie, which acts as a middleman for the colonial bourgeoisie and claims to represent the universal rights of people only as a means of furthering its own interests. His work does not elaborate the specific ways in which nationalism affects everyday life, as everyday life on the periphery is so deeply enmeshed in colonial rule that only a radical rupture—violence—seems capable of triggering the development of an authentic national consciousness.

zh: 对民族主义与日常生活的探究要求澄清“社会”。尽管社会在法农的民族主义论述中分量很重，但作为概念，它在阶级剥削与对抗的领域之外基本上未被定义。社会不平等在他《全世界受苦的人》（The Wretched of the Earth）对城乡分裂的分析中讨论得最明显。这一分裂指被殖民者与殖民者的划分。它也指被建构为对抗性与剥削性的社会经济关系。

在法农摩尼教式的分析中，殖民主义加剧对劳动力的剥削，却不引入任何发展技术、灌溉、新作物与生产方法的现代化手段。对法农而言，这种经济支配由种族政治维持与再生产——种族政治把社会对抗移入政治与意识形态舞台。人民克服种族主义的愿望扰乱了他们的主体意识，并遮蔽了他们的社会意识。但由于他没有阐述民族与种族政治构成剥削性经济关系的方式，法农著作中并不清楚社会如何不同于经济、文化政治如何塑造生产与交换的社会经验。理解殖民统治下的日常生活，迫使我们追问：殖民统治如何不仅奠基在社会对抗的种族倒置或启蒙的援引之上，而且奠基在社会关系的改革之上——这些改革使人们能够想象新的农业生产与消费方式。
en: An inquiry into nationalism and everyday life demands clarification of the social. Despite its weight in Fanon’s account of nationalism the social, as a concept, is largely undefined beyond the domain of class exploitation and antagonism. Social inequality is discussed most visibly in his analysis of the divide between rural and urban in The Wretched of the Earth. This divide refers to the division of colonized and colonizer. It also signifies socioeconomic relations that are construed as antagonistic and exploitative.

In Fanon’s Manichaean analysis, colonialism intensifies the exploitation of labor power without introducing any means of modernization to develop technology, irrigation, and new crops and methods of production. For Fanon, this economic domination is maintained and reproduced by racial politics, which moves social antagonism into the political and ideological arena. The desire of people to overcome racism confounds their subjectivity and overshadows their social consciousness. But because he does not elaborate the ways in which national and racial politics constitute economic relations of exploitation, it is not clear in Fanon’s work how the social differs from the economic and how cultural politics shapes the social experience of production and exchange. An understanding of everyday life under colonial rule compels us to ask how colonial rule is grounded not only in the racial inversion of social antagonism or the invocation of enlightenment but also in reforms in social relations that enable people to imagine new modes of agricultural production and consumption.

zh: 众多后殖民研究使其殖民主义与民族主义分析远离经济关系。这一取向主要关注民族观念如何经四处活动的殖民者和殖民国家等渠道，从“西方”传到“其余地方”（West to the Rest）。这一取向的基线由本尼迪克特·安德森（Benedict Anderson）提供：他把民族主义概念化为一种在公共空间中流通、没有主导代理人的大众意识。在他看来，民族主义不是特定阶级或政治动员的产物，而是通过阅读印刷材料与观看物件的同时而重复的活动涌现的跨阶级认同。正是通过这些活动，人们开始想象自己与生活在特定有界领土内他人的联系，并理解这样一个世界：事件之间的联系未必依时间先后或因果关系而建立。这种模块式大众民族主义一旦存在，便通过多波殖民化在从非洲、俄国到日本、印度尼西亚的被殖民国家被模仿。当马基雅维利式的殖民国家与克里奥尔精英有意识地统一方言、重造传统与历史、推广现代教育时，现代民族主义原有的大众性与横向联结在非西方世界丧失了。
en: Numerous postcolonial studies distance their analyses of colonialism and nationalism from economic relations. A key concern is the dissemination of the idea of the nation from the “West to the Rest” through institutions such as traveling colonizers and the colonial state. A baseline for this orientation was provided by Benedict Anderson’s conceptualization of nationalism as a popular consciousness circulating in public space without master agents. In his view, nationalism is not a product of a specific class or political mobilization but a cross-class identification that emerges through the simultaneous and repeated activities of reading print materials and seeing objects. It is through these activities that people come to imagine their connection with others living within a particular bounded territory and apprehend a world in which connections among events are not necessarily linked temporally or causally. Once it came to exist, this modular form of popular nationalism was imitated in colonized countries from Africa and Russia to Japan and Indonesia through many waves of colonization. As Machiavellian colonial states and creole elites consciously unified vernaculars, re-created their traditions and histories, and promoted modern education, the original popular and horizontal characteristic of modern nationalism became lost in the non-Western world.

zh: 当殖民支配的论述被化约为现代性观念的生产时，民族与民族主义的分析就与资本主义发展脱钩。安德森把印刷资本主义认定为推动模块式现代性形成的力量。按哈里·哈鲁图尼安（Harry Harootunian）的说法，安德森框架中的这种促动作用“更多关乎印刷而非资本主义的政治经济学，更多关乎共同性的传达而非资本主义生产关系与生产力的破坏性拉平”。
然而在他对殖民地派生民族主义的分析中，连这种最低限度的资本主义也消失了——在那里民族主义已成为现代化的启蒙工程。
en: When accounts of colonial domination are reduced to the production of ideas of modernity, the analysis of nation and nationalism becomes dissociated from capitalist development. Anderson identifies print capitalism as the agent that creates a modular form of modernity. According to Harry Harootunian, this agency in Anderson’s framework says “more about print than the political economy of capitalism, more about communicating commonalities than the destructive leveling of capitalist productive relations and forces.”
Yet even this minimal sense of capitalism disappears in his analysis of derivative nationalisms in colonies, where nationalism has become the enlightenment project of modernization.

zh: 庶民研究（subaltern studies）有类似的把资本主义边缘化的倾向。帕塔·查特吉（Partha Chatterjee）在未受殖民支配触及的精神领域寻找反殖民民族主义。拉纳吉特·古哈（Ranajit Guha）考察民族精英如何在反殖民运动中挪用宗主国的语言与价值，例如以印度教仪式作为新民族的象征，以及采用文明与不文明的二元观念。启蒙的殖民话语在民族精英与劳动人民之间制造深刻裂隙。不守规矩的传统行为与有序的现代行为之间的对立，是精英成员与庶民之间距离的症候。
在这类分析中，殖民主义与反殖民民族主义在概念上与历史上都被剥离了与资本主义的关联。殖民化整合宗主国社会及其殖民地，同时使殖民地同质化并把它们变为民族。但殖民整合也持续维持宗主国社会与殖民地社会之间的差异——这些差异正是资本主义整合的条件。
en: Subaltern studies shares a similar tendency to sideline capitalism. Partha Chatterjee seeks anticolonial nationalism in a spiritual domain untouched by colonial domination. Ranajit Guha examines how national elites appropriate the language and values of the metropole in their anticolonial movements, for example, Hindu rituals as a symbol of a new nation and the binary conception of civilized and uncivilized. The colonial discourse of enlightenment engenders a deep rift between national elites and laboring people. The opposition of unruly traditional behaviors and orderly modern ones is symptomatic of the distance between members of the elite and subalterns.

In such analyses, colonialism and anticolonial nationalism are removed conceptually and historically from their association with capitalism. Colonization integrates metropolitan society and its colonies while homogenizing the colonies and turning them into nations. But colonial integration also continues to maintain the differences between metropolitan and colonial societies, which are conditions for capitalist integration.

zh: 当殖民主义与民族主义研究忽视资本主义时，“人民”主要指国民——其主体性与现代主体的其他要素脱钩：“自由”劳动、有产者及其关系。尽管庶民研究力求恢复被民族历史编纂抹去的庶民声音与经验，它却重述了民族精英所构想的庶民观。这些论述缺失的是这样一个过程：民族精英对庶民的表述如何塑造了他们在日常生活其他领域中的社会关系——在那里他们作为不同社会经济群体相遇。启蒙框架把主体形成置于线性空间：有产、受教育的阶级作为被殖民精英的先锋被给予优先，劳动者则被贬到后来者的低下位置。在这一启蒙框架中，文盲劳动者构成建立现代民族国家的障碍。他们成为民族运动或殖民国家工程的对象——这些工程力求向他们灌输新伦理、赋予他们现代主体的新角色与地位。这种路径剥夺了劳动人民构想自身主体性的手段。当查特吉指责安德森剥夺被殖民者想象自己民族的手段时，他似乎没有意识到自己也倾向于剥夺劳动庶民想象自己对身心之主权的手段。将现代主体置于线性发展序列的做法把殖民者与被殖民者的关系混同于熟悉的发展时滞观念——这一观念无法说明由资本、劳动与其他商品交换产生的不平衡且相互构成的关系。
en: When capitalism is disregarded in studies of colonialism and nationalism, the people mainly refers to nationals whose subjectivities are detached from other elements of modern subjects: “free” labor, propertied people, and their relations. Although subaltern studies seeks to reinstate subaltern voices and experiences that were effaced from national historiographies, it recapitulates views on the subaltern conceived by national elites. Missing in these accounts is the process through which the representation of the subaltern by national elites shaped their social relationship in other domains of their everyday lives, where they were encountered as different socioeconomic groups. The enlightenment framework placed subject formation in a linear space, where the propertied, educated class is given precedence as the vanguard of colonized elites and laborers are relegated to the inferior position of latecomers. In this enlightenment framework, illiterate laborers pose a barrier to establishing a modern nation-state. They become objects of a national movement or colonial state project that seeks to instill in them new ethics and assign to them the new roles and status of modern subjects. This approach dispossesses laboring people of the means of conceiving their own subjectivity. When he charges Anderson with depriving the colonized of the means to imagine their own nation, Partha Chatterjee seems oblivious of his own tendency to divest laboring subalterns of the means to imagine their own sovereignty over their minds and bodies. The linear mapping of the modern subject conflates the relationship between colonizer and colonized with the familiar notion of the time lag of development, a notion that cannot account for uneven and mutually constitutive relations arising from the exchange of capital, labor, and other commodities.

zh: 当人民性与劳动和交换的社会关系分离时，“社会”指构成公民社会的“自由”个人之间的联合——被殖民者必须向殖民者学习它才能成为现代主体。这种把人民与其物质条件分离的问题，源于把书面语言置于其他现代经验之上的实践。对亨利·列斐伏尔（Henri Lefebvre）而言，过度强调书面文字、忽视其他社会实践，导致透明性幻觉——心智活动与社会活动之间看似忠实的对应。鉴于把观念导入实践所涉及的步骤，没有根据假定观念的预期目的得以实现。也没有理由假定社会经验可以等同于意识的实现。
殖民主义与民族主义的启蒙路径也假定这种忠实对应，却不考察阅读、想象与思想表述如何受社会条件与历史偶然性约束。民族的文化想象被赋予主体地位。现代主体被视为主要通过阅读与想象的心智活动形成，并被从劳动的社会领域移除。这种主体表述抹去了如下观念：殖民主义是一种使社会关系商品化的政治与经济支配形式。
en: When peoplehood is separated from the social relations of work and exchange, the social refers to the associations among “free” individuals that constitute civil society, which the colonized must learn from the colonizer in order to be modern. This problem of separating people from their material conditions arises from the practice of privileging written language over other modern experiences. For Henri Lefebvre, overemphasis on the written word and inattention to other social practices lead to the illusion of transparency, with its seeming fidelity between mental and social activities. Given the steps involved in channeling ideas into practices, there is no basis for assuming realization of the intended purposes of ideas. Nor is there any reason to assume that social experience can be equated with an enactment of consciousness.

The enlightenment approach to colonialism and nationalism also assumes such fidelity without examining how reading, imagination, and articulation of thoughts are constrained by social conditions and historical contingency. The cultural imaginary of the nation is given the status of a subject. The modern subject is seen to be formed mainly through the mental activities of reading and imagining and is removed from the social domain of work. This formulation of the subject erases the notion that colonialism is a form of political and economic domination that commodifies social relations.

zh: 把资本主义带入民族主义分析，使我们能够把民族主义置于社会领域。资本主义现代性与民族主义的关系，既不能通过资本积累的目的论意图、也不能通过启蒙的线性轨迹来理解。
en: Bringing capitalism into the analysis of nationalism enables us to place nationalism in the social domain. The relationship between capitalist modernity and nationalism is to be understood neither by the teleological intention of capital accumulation nor by the linear trajectory of enlightenment.

zh: 相反，必须同时追踪精英对人民的表述，以及那些运用文化、历史与观念解释这种表述、并转变自身与他人关系的人的活生生的经验。民族主义在资本主义与社会讨论中的位置，将在下一节处理。
en: Rather, it is imperative to pursue both the representation of people by elites and the lived experience of those who use culture, history, and ideas to interpret the representation and transform their relations with others. The place of nationalism in the discussion of capitalism and the social is addressed in the next section.

zh: 资本主义之床
en: the capitalist bed

zh: 民族主义与资本主义都构成一个民族的现代主权。在其功能与效应中首要的是：它们抽象化人与人之间、人与物之间的社会关系。以人民与土地为例，我探讨民族主义与资本主义实现这种抽象化方式的共性与差异。民族主义与资本主义都标准化、同质化社会关系。二者共同赋予人民与土地以普遍性。首先，个人被设想为成员与生产者，其彼此关系被标准化与同质化。民族主义把个人指定为共同体成员，其身份由普遍权利与同质的归属感定义。想象中的归属纽带与平等观念在国民之间发展——他们的社会关系可能被居住地、特定传统与方言分隔，但同时又通过商品的不平等交易交织在一起。资本主义也把不同地方的个人整合进新的生产与流通组织。新的生产规模与分工体系强制推行新的劳动时间与劳动空间性，而不顾个别工人劳动所处的千差万别的境况。人类劳动的价值由其在市场上的价格衡量——市场把社会关系扭曲为物与物之间的关系，这些关系脱离生产者、外在于生产者而存在。
en: Both nationalism and capitalism constitute the modern sovereignty of a people. Foremost among their functions and effects, they abstract social relations between people and between people and things. Taking people and land as examples, I explore commonalities and differences in the ways that nationalism and capitalism effect this abstraction. Both nationalism and capitalism standardize and homogenize social relations. Together nationalism and capitalism assign universality to people and land. To begin with, individuals are conceived to be members and producers whose relations with one another are standardized and homogenized. Nationalism designates individuals as members of a community whose identities are defined by universal rights and a homogeneous sense of belonging. Imagined attachments and notions of equality develop among nationals whose social relations may be separated by residence, particular traditions, and vernaculars but at the same time are interwoven through unequal transactions of things. Capitalism also integrates individuals of different locales into new organizations of production and circulation. New scales of production and systems of division of labor enforce new labor time and spatiality of work, without regard for the wide range of circumstances under which individual workers labor. The value of human labor is measured by its price in a market that deforms social relations into relations among things, relations that exist apart from and outside the producers.

zh: 土地也经过两种使其同质化的抽象。民族主义把土地自然化为领土，划出民族共同体内部与外部的界线。内部被视为单一空间，一个由其外部的反面所决定的实体。这种把领土建构为民族空间的过程既是制度的也是想象的：民族通信与交通网络消灭个人之间的空间距离与差异，把个人身份绑定于领土。切断与生产者及历史的先前依恋之后，土地也被商品化，以与人民相同的方式进入市场。在财产法保护下，土地的价值从生产者那里异化——提高其生产力的是生产者的劳动力，而非市场。作为商品，土地通过流通积累价值，其价值则通过市场交换被标准化。土地也被垄断：财产所有者排除其他潜在使用者与生产者。
en: Land also acquires the double abstraction of homogenization. Nationalism naturalizes land as territory, drawing a demarcation between the inside and the outside of a national community. The inside is regarded as a singular space, an entity determined by the inverse of its outside. This construction of territory as a national space is both an institutional and an imagined process, as national communication and transportation grids annihilate spatial distances and differences between individuals, binding the identities of individuals to territory. Severed from previous attachments to producers and histories, land also becomes commodified, entering the market in the same ways that people do. Protected by property law, the value of land is alienated from producers whose labor power, not the market, improves its productivity. As a commodity, land accrues its value through circulation, while its value is standardized through market exchange. Land is also monopolized as property owners exclude other potential users and producers.

zh: 民族主义与资本主义的社会抽象由相反的时空性动力驱动。前者把社会关系固定为想象实体的绝对属性，后者则使其不断变化、持续流通。被设想为封闭系统的民族共同体被设定为持久实体，以文化习语与统一性的坚实结构捆绑其成员。

传统、族群区分与历史记忆被认为赋予民族共同体空间整体性与时间韧性的象征品质。想象与召唤的精神隐喻表现这种绝对的空间统一性——个人与群体似乎随时都能复活它。民族主义是似乎永不变化的东西；更准确地说，它若要维持自身存在就必须不变化。没有这种恒常性，民族就失去价值。人民被召唤为超时间的主体，他们扎根土地的生活往往为共同体提供世代延续性。土地体现人民经验的记忆：作为主观情感、农业中的重复劳动，或生产者的主权。
当国家建构国民与非国民的边界、把外国人从土地上移除时，其合法性部分奠基在它自我宣称的代表人民及其历史记忆的权利之上。
en: The social abstractions of nationalism and capitalism are driven by the opposite dynamics of spatio-temporality. The former fixes social relations as an absolute quality of an imagined entity, while the latter renders them ever changing and in constant circulation. Conceived as a system of closure, a national community is posited as a durable entity that binds its members with a solid structure of cultural idioms and unity.

Tradition, ethnic distinctions, and historical memory are presumed to endow a national community with symbolic qualities of spatial wholeness and temporal resilience. The spiritual metaphors of imagination and invocation represent this absolute spatial unity, which individuals and groups seem to be able to resurrect at any time. Nationalism is a thing that seems never to change, and more precisely it must not change if it is to maintain its existence. Without this constancy, the nation loses its value. People are invoked as timeless subjects, and their lives rooted in the land often provide the community with continuity over the generations. Land embodies the memory of people’s experience: as subjective sentiments, repetitive work in farming, or the sovereignty of producers.

When the state constructs the boundary between nationals and nonnationals and removes foreigners from land, its legitimacy is grounded in part in its self-proclaimed right to represent the people and their historical memory.

zh: 重复的流通标志资本主义对人民与土地的改造。与生产资料分离的个人必须不断出卖劳动，其价值由不断变化的供给、产品的流通与利润再投入生产所决定。资本主义把土地从单纯的财富源泉变为商品。作为财富源泉，土地是生产资料，生产者用它生产财富并与地主和国家分享。作为商品，土地成为虚拟资本，通过与货币及其他商品的无尽交换改变自身价值。例如，租地者向土地所有者支付的地租，就像为购买土地所花货币的利息。地租决定必需的生活资料水平，使剩余成为利润。与封建地主相反，在资本主义生产方式中，地主与政府债券、股票、企业股份等资产的投资者无异。只要土地所有权凭证在市场上流通，土地也就转化为货币。
在商品与货币的无尽交换中，土地成为虚拟资本。
en: Repetitive circulation marks the capitalist transformation of people and land. Separated from the means of production, individuals must continuously sell their labor, whose value is determined by its changing supply, the circulation of its products, and the reinvestment of profits into production. Capitalism transforms land from a mere source of wealth into a commodity. As a source of wealth, land is a means of production with which producers produce wealth and share it with landlords and the state. As a commodity, land becomes fictitious capital, altering its value through its endless exchange with money and other commodities. For instance, ground rent paid by renters to landowners is like interest on money spent to purchase land. Ground rent determines the necessary level of subsistence, rendering the surplus as profit. In contrast to feudal landlords, in the capitalist mode of production landlords are no different from investors in assets such as government bonds, stocks, and shares of enterprises. To the extent that land titles circulate in the market, land is also converted to money.
In an endless exchange of commodities and money, land becomes fictitious capital.

zh: 民族主义与资本主义对社会关系的重叠抽象，要求考察二者互动中涌现的具体历史配置。我把这一点阐述为理解民族主义与资本主义关系的替代框架。但首先，让我检视关于资本主义与民族主义的既有研究，尤其关注阶级霸权的那些。
这些承袭的路径依赖一种空间性的民族观念与一种局限于社会体边界的“社会”观念——这些概念妨碍观察资本主义与民族主义之间的矛盾。
en: The overlapping abstractions of social relations made by nationalism and capitalism require an investigation of the specific historical configurations that emerge in their interactions. I elaborate this point as an alternative framework for understanding the relationship between nationalism and capitalism. But first, let me examine the existing scholarship on capitalism and nationalism, especially those concerned with class hegemony.

These received approaches draw on a spatial conception of the nation and a society bound conception of the social, concepts that inhibit observation of the contradictions between capitalism and nationalism.

zh: 关于民族主义与资本主义的研究主要关注民族对资本主义的影响，而非二者对社会关系的相互构成。文献中一个具体探究领域是：民族主义如何使资本主义能够在社会不平等之下创造并再生产自身的生产与流通条件。虽然这些论述并未认为资本主义的内在逻辑必然会催生民族或民族国家，但民族主义的政治与意识形态功能被描绘得天衣无缝，以致资本主义似乎依赖民族主义来生产与再生产自身。各种民族主义与资本主义研究仍然——尽管微妙地——暗示社会关系的意识形态倒置：从不平等、分裂的人民到整合、统一的个人。这种倾向在把民族主义与资本主义的互动定位于政治与意识形态地形的实践中尤其明显，仿佛生产与流通的社会关系只由资本主义的经济力量支配。
en: Scholarship on nationalism and capitalism primarily has been concerned with the effect of the nation on capitalism rather than their mutual constitution of social relations. A specific area of inquiry in the literature is the issue of how nationalism enables capitalism to create and reproduce its own conditions for production and circulation despite social inequality. While no inherent logic of capitalism is assumed in calling a nation or nation-state into existence, the political and ideological function of nationalism is portrayed as seamless to the degree that capitalism seems to depend on nationalism for its production and reproduction. Various studies of nationalism and capitalism still imply, though subtly, the ideological inversion of social relations from unequal and divided people to integrated and unified individuals. This tendency is particularly evident in the practice of locating the interaction of nationalism and capitalism in political and ideological terrains, as if social relations of production and circulation were governed only by the economic forces of capitalism.

zh: 霸权的经典概念处理殖民与民族权力如何嵌入社会空间的问题。经典讨论把霸权的形成描述为一种特定社会意识在历史中的扩散。这种特定社会意识把阶级对抗倒置为民族共同体中普遍且彼此平等的成员身份——即便不算完全体现一种误认。在阶级政治中，当一个阶级无力仅凭强制取得支配时，民族主义使支配阶级能够把自身利益表现为与共同体普遍目标同一。
在这种霸权政治中，对民族共同体的召唤中和了社会对抗。支配权力集团把自己认同为不是阶级、而是对立权力的“他者”，同时把其阶级目标表现为反对共同敌人的民族—民众斗争。霸权政治中的民众—民主要素把主体建构为“人民”而非阶级成员。
例如，在纳粹主义话语中，德国工人被建构为德国人与工人——以分离这两种身份的方式；否则两种身份的融合就会把社会主义表现为符合德国人民的历史利益。
在市场与意识形态政治两个领域，民族主义话语的运作方式都是确保群众参与资本主义体系。
en: The canonical notion of hegemony addresses the issue of how colonial and national power is embedded in social space. Classic discussions document the invention of hegemony as the historical metastasizing of a particular social consciousness. This specific social consciousness inverts class antagonism into a universal and horizontal membership in a national community, if not completely embodying a false recognition. In class politics, where a class cannot afford to attain dominance through coercion alone, nationalism enables the dominant class to represent its own interests as identical to the universal aims of community.

In this politics of hegemony, the invocation of national community neutralizes social antagonism. The dominant power bloc identifies itself not as a class but as the “other” of the opposed power, while presenting its class objective as the national-popular struggle against common enemies. The popular-democratic elements in hegemonic politics constitute subjects as “the people” rather than members of a class.

For instance, in the discourse of nazism, a German worker was construed as German and a worker in ways that separate these two identities; otherwise the fusion of the two identities would represent socialism as being in the historical interest of the German people.
In the domains of both the market and ideological politics, the discourse of nationalism performs in such a way as to secure the participation of the masses in a capitalist system.

zh: 霸权争论的阿喀琉斯之踵在于：政治与意识形态领导权是否以及如何奠基在物质条件之中。尽管已有各种澄清尝试，政治与意识形态同物质条件的连接仍基本上未被探索。

把阶级主体倒置为自由个人或民族人民，预设其身份的分裂：经济身份与政治或意识形态身份被分别建构。倒置这一棘手问题依赖把社会概念化为由彼此区分的经济、政治与意识形态领域构成的总体系统。把政治与意识形态视为半自主领域——只在归根结底的意义上由物质关系决定——的观念，只有在其与物质生产关系的联系被预设时，才证成仅在政治与意识形态领域分析民族—民众（national-popular）。例如，对民族—民众的分析倾向于集中于政治与意识形态关系中人民的建构。霸权与组织私有财产制度及生产流通关系的具体社会计划之间的联系，更多是隐含而非被阐明的。
en: The Achilles’ heel in debates on hegemony is the issue of whether and how political and ideological leadership is grounded in material conditions. While various attempts have been made to clarify the issue, the linkage of the political and ideological with material conditions remains largely unexplored.

The inversion of class subjects into free individuals or the nation’s people presumes a split of their identities, with each constituted separately as economic and political/ideological. The vexed question of inversion draws on the conceptualization of the social as a system of totality that consists of distinct economic, political, and ideological spheres. The conception of the political and ideological as semiautonomous domains—determined only in the last instance by material relations—justifies the analysis of the national popular in the political and ideological domain only when their links to material relations of production are presumed. The analysis of the national popular, for instance, tends to concentrate on the construction of people in political and ideological relations. More implicit than illustrated are linkages between hegemony and the concrete social programs that organize the system of private property and relations of production and circulation.

zh: “接合”（articulation）或社会形态的观念提供了另一种社会概念，帮助我们理解民族主义作为构成生产过程的力量。对尼科斯·普兰查斯（Nicos Poulantzas）而言，阿尔都塞式把社会理解为由相互分立的领域组成的结构总体，有可能把经济关系表现为在资本主义不同阶段自我调节、不变的东西。普兰查斯反驳经典观念——即意识形态作为理想与表象神秘化、掩盖或倒置社会关系，仿佛经济是给定的。相反，他考察政治与意识形态介入生产关系的方式，以及民族国家在社会分工时空矩阵中的运作。福特主义生产体制中的泰勒主义分工把生产过程分解为细微的去技能化任务，由工人执行——工人因此被剥夺对整体的视野。这一资本主义生产体制中的社会关系被割裂、分隔到一个个隔间般的空间，并由不同种类的时间控制：机器的运转时间表、工头的秒表、资本的周转时间。
en: An alternative conception of the social is provided by the notion of “articulation” or social formation, which helps us to understand nationalism as a force that constitutes the process of production. For Nicos Poulantzas, the Althusserian concept of the social as a structural totality of separate spheres risks representing economic relations as self-regulating and unchanging in different stages of capitalism. Poulantzas refutes the classic notion that, as ideals and representations, ideology mystifies, conceals, or inverts social relations, as if the economic were given. Instead he examines the ways in which the political and ideological intervene in the relations of production and the nation-state performs in the spatio-temporal matrix of the social division of labor. The Taylorist division of labor in the Fordist regime of production divides the production process into minute deskilled tasks performed by workers who are thus denied a vision of the whole. Social relations in this capitalist regime of production are fractured and parceled into cellular spaces and controlled by different kinds of time, including the operating schedules of machines, the stopwatches of foremen, and the turnover time of capital.

zh: 串联而分割的空间与时间提出协调与整合的问题。人们假定民族将承担这一任务。正是在阶级斗争与国家政策中，民族与生产关系接合。由军队、学校、监狱等国家装置召唤出来的民族领土观念，把个人整合进人民—民族的新空间。由国家呈现的民族历史与传统同质化时间序列，提供新的参照框架。按普兰查斯的说法，全球资本主义依赖民族，体现为资本的跨国扩张本身就是一个“民族间化”（inter-nationalization）的过程。资本并不铺满全球的同质空间，而是填充民族之间的裂隙。
国家通过获取新边疆寻求扩张资本与领土。它把边疆封装进民族空间，同质化、同化并统一生产与交换的条件。
en: Serial and segmented space and time raise the problem of coordination and integration. It is assumed that the nation will take up this task. It is in the class struggle and state policy that the nation is articulated with relations of production. Conjured up by state apparatuses such as the military, schools, and prisons, the notion of national territory integrates individuals into the new space of a people-nation. Represented by the state, national history and tradition homogenize temporal sequences and provide a new frame of reference. According to Poulantzas, global capitalism depends on the nation to the degree that the transnational expansion of capital is a process of “inter-nationalization.” Capital does not spread throughout the homogeneous space of the global but rather fills in the breaches between nations.

The state seeks to expand capital and territory by acquiring new frontiers. It encapsulates frontiers into national spaces, homogenizing, assimilating, and unifying the conditions of production and exchange.

zh: 倒置论题与接合论题都派生自民族的时空性观念。两个论题无一例外把民族视为固定空间。它们把民族化约为同质化社会差异与对抗的功能，并假定这是民族的本体论权力。被设想为封闭系统，民族被视为把资本主义内在的差异、对立与对抗凝聚为一个称作民族共同体的单位。统一或整合的预设效应是组织与维持资本主义扩张。没有任何制度过程或事件被视为能转变民族。事实上，不稳定、尤其现代民族的可转变性，似乎与民族定义本身相悖。民族被认为体现一种独特的民众主义：不同于民主、自由、平等的其他民众话语，它嵌入独特而不可化约的历史经验。因此它被期望为历史话语提供异常稳定的参照框架，并成为“比社会结构本身更坚实的双重意义结构”的基础。
此外，民族超时间的时间性强化了空间整体性的形象——把具体当下（事情往往碎片化、争议性、对抗性）运送到期望的未来。这种观念把民族描绘为空洞的漂浮能指，其内容不如将它与其他要素接合的行动者重要。这是因为决定民族话语实际意义与政治价值的不是民族的内容而是阶级政治。取决于其阶级政治的性质，民族话语可能成为知识分子的修辞抽象，或成为民族—民众集团形成的基础。
en: The theses of inversion and articulation are both derived from the notion of the spatio-temporality of the nation. The theses invariably consider the nation to be a fixed space. They reduce it to its function of homogenizing social difference and antagonism and assume this to be the ontological power of the nation. Conceived as a system of closure, the nation is seen to distill the inherent differences, oppositions, and antagonisms of capitalism into a unit called the national community. The presumed effect of unity or integration is to organize and maintain capitalist expansion. No type of institutional process or event is seen to transform the nation. In fact, instability and especially the transformability of the modern nation seem to be antithetical to the definition of the nation itself. The nation is thought to embody a distinct kind of populism, which, unlike the other popular discourses of democracy, liberty, and equality, is embedded in unique and irreducible historical experiences. It is therefore expected to provide an unusually stable frame of reference for historical discourse and the basis for a more “solid double structure of meanings than the social structure itself.”

Furthermore, the nation’s temporality of timelessness accentuates the image of spatial wholeness that transports the concrete present—where matters are often fragmented, contentious, and antagonistic—to a desired future. This notion depicts the nation as an empty, floating signifier whose contents are less relevant than the agents who articulate it. This is because it is not the content of the nation but class politics that determines the actual meaning of national discourses and political value. Depending on the nature of its class politics, the discourse of the nation could become a rhetorical abstraction for intellectuals or a basis for the formation of a national popular bloc.

zh: 这种民族的时空概念化把精神性与稳定性混为一谈。由于民族必须显得稳定才能执行其统一功能，其意识形态效应被混同于其稳定性。尼尔·史密斯（Neil Smith）与辛迪·卡茨（Cindi Katz）指出，空间“在几何上可分割为离散的片段”，因此民族的空间观念把内与外的边界表现为仿佛其范畴是互斥的领域，而非相互构成的领域。

同样，上面检视的民族与资本主义讨论预设内与外之间的民族边界是完整而无争议的。空间隐喻已成为理解民族经验的主要手段。例如，自由劳动者被迫离开生产资料与生产对象，同时作为国内市场的自由个人或民族共同体的主权人民被“再领土化”。纳入民族成员身份被假定为一次性过程。被纳入者之间的划分被认为应被抹去。绝对而单一的空间观念掩盖了如下事实：民族形成中的空间实践涉及复杂政治——内与外的边界持续受到基于社会经济地位、种族、性别与性态的内部人差异、以及内部人与外部人之间差异的争夺。
en: This spatio-temporal conceptualization of the nation confounds spirituality with stability. As the nation must appear to remain stable in order to perform its unifying function, its ideological effect is confused with its stability. Neil Smith and Cindi Katz point out that space is “geometrically divisible into discrete bits,” so the spatial conception of the nation renders the boundaries of inside and outside as if their categories are mutually exclusive rather than mutually constituted domains.

Similarly, the discussions of the nation and capitalism examined above presume that the national boundary between inside and outside is complete and uncontested. Spatial metaphors have become a primary means by which national experience is understood. For example, free laborers are “displaced” from the means and objects of production, while they are “reterritorialized” as free individuals in an internal market or as the sovereign people of a national community. Incorporation into national membership is assumed to be a one-time process. The divisions among those who are included are supposed to be erased. The conception of an absolute and singular space elides the fact that spatial practices in nation formation involve a complex politics in which the boundary between inside and outside continues to be contested by differences among insiders based on socioeconomic status, race, gender, and sexuality, as well as the differences between insiders and outsiders.

zh: 把民族的稳定化作用视为不证自明倾向于把社会（the social）等同于社会体（society）。资本主义是一个内在的全球过程：劳动与资本的流入跨越民族国家的领土边界，同时维持地方之间的不平衡。因此，民族在整合、倒置与接合资本主义过程中的经典功能绝非绝对。把社会体视为自足实体的观念，不过是民族在遏制与稳定全球资本主义动力时所期望的效应。当民族被想象为在给定社会中维持均衡、同化外部力量时，这种效应更多关乎资本的要求而非实际。当霸权领导的不稳定被承认时，它常被归因于国家间动力或社会体内部政治。对恩内斯托·拉克劳（Ernesto Laclau）而言，阶级政治从不完全决定民族的意义。意识形态领域的某种开放性使特定民族观念无法在霸权政治中定局。即使普兰查斯注意到全球资本主义同时需要并超越民族边界施加的空间限制，他那开创性研究也没有处理全球资本主义矛盾动力对民族—民众政治的意涵。我们留下未答的问题：民族主义在哪些方面未能遏制资本主义力量？民族主义对资本主义的不完全中介对社会关系意味着什么？它对民族的时空性又有何意涵？
en: The axiom of the stabilizing effect of the nation tends to equate the social with society. Capitalism is an inherently global process in which influxes of labor and capital transgress the territorial boundaries of national states while maintaining unevenness between places. Thus, the canonical function of the nation in integrating, inverting, and articulating capitalist processes is by no means absolute. The conception of a society as a self-contained entity is nothing but a desired effect of the nation in containing and stabilizing the dynamics of global capitalism. When the nation is imagined to maintain equilibrium and assimilate external forces in a given society, this effect is more about the requirements of capital than about actuality. When the instability of hegemonic leadership is recognized, it is often ascribed to interstate dynamics or intrasocietal politics. For Ernesto Laclau, class politics never completely determines the meaning of the nation. A certain openness in the ideological domain makes it impossible to settle the notion of a specific nation in hegemonic politics. Even when Poulantzas notes that global capitalism simultaneously requires and transcends the spatial restrictions imposed by national frontiers, his pathbreaking study does not address the implications of the contradictory dynamics of global capitalism for national-popular politics. We are left with unanswered questions. In what ways does nationalism fail to contain capitalist forces? What does the incomplete mediation of capitalism by nationalism mean for social relations? And what are its implications for the spatio-temporality of the nation?

zh: 下一节我将阐述全球资本主义与民族主义的相互构成或共时接合，以展示二者内在的张力——这一张力可以在社会关系层面得到说明。尽管民族主义的起源与运作不可化约为资本主义过程，我的探究限于民族形成与全球资本主义动力相关的方式。
en: In the next section, I elaborate on the mutual constitution or coeval articulation of global capitalism and nationalism in order to show their intrinsic tension, which is explicated in the terrain of the social. Although the origin and work of nationalism are irreducible to capitalist processes, my inquiry limits itself to the ways in which nation formation is pertinent to the dynamics of global capitalism.

zh: 民族的时间性与社会
en: temporality of the nation and the social

zh: 民族主义与资本主义之间的结构张力源于全球资本主义的矛盾动力：它同时同质化与差异化生产与交换的社会关系。资本必须克服其流通的障碍，但社会障碍又是资本流动的必要条件——因为工资、劳动与财产法、基础设施等社会差异促使资本把生产与市场活动从一个地区重新定位到另一个地区。
地区之间的社会差异使人们能够为寻找经济机会而移动。民族制造地方之间的社会差异，把一个地方变为民族，并在地方之间划出牢固边界。民族国家创造基础设施、通信网络与法律，使资本能在其边界内有利可图地投资。然而资本与劳动也寻求把经济活动重新定位到国外，使国内基础设施投资面临贬值的风险。
en: The structural tension between nationalism and capitalism arises from contradictory dynamics of global capitalism that simultaneously homogenize and differentiate social relations of production and exchange. While capital must overcome barriers to its circulation, social barriers are a necessary condition for the mobility of capital, since social differences such as wages, labor and property laws, and infrastructure motivate capital to relocate production and market activities from one region to another.

Social differences between regions make it possible for people to move in search of economic opportunities. The nation creates social differences between places, turning a place into a nation and drawing firm boundaries between places. A nation-state creates infrastructure, communications networks, and laws that enable capital to be profitably invested within its boundaries. However, capital and labor also seek to relocate their economic activities abroad, threatening devaluation of investment in national infrastructures.

zh: 这种结构张力对社会关系产生效应。在结构性论述中，民族被与国家创造民族市场与基础设施的角色等同起来。然而作为文化与意识形态力量，民族抽象化社会关系。当与资本主义接合时，民族使人与物之间的资本主义关系以特定方式呈现。民族主义话语与政治可能包含对资本主义关系的特定表述。例如，农业共同体主义——一种原型式的民族主义话语——批判私有财产制度与市场动力。它提供重新分配剩余价值的替代方式，组织新的分工，并设定小农为新国民经济的脊梁。正是通过这些情势性过程，我们才能考察民族主义表述的具体形式，以想象资本主义的替代方案。由于民族主义对社会经验构成的内在效应，民族与资本主义的接合不能化约为单一功能。民族与资本主义共时接合的历史变体涉及多种关于如何表述这些关系的文化政治——资本主义关系在具体历史时刻通过这些政治被解释与修改。
en: This structural tension has an effect on social relations. In the structural accounts, the nation is made consubstantial with the role of the state in creating a national market and infrastructure. Yet as a cultural and ideological force the nation abstracts social relations. When it is articulated with capitalism, the nation represents the capitalist relations among people and things. Nationalist discourses and politics may entail specific representations of capitalist relations. For instance, agrarian communitarianism, an archetypal nationalist discourse, critiques the private property system and market dynamics. It supplies an alternative way to redistribute surplus value, organizing a new division of labor and postulating small farmers as the backbone of a new national economy. It is through these conjunctural processes that we can examine specific forms of nationalist representation in order to imagine an alternative to capitalism. Because of the immanent effect of nationalism on the constitution of social experiences, the nation’s articulation with capitalism cannot be reduced to a single function. Historical inflections of the coeval articulation of the nation and capitalism involve diverse cultural politics of representation through which capitalist relations are interpreted and modified in specific historical moments.

zh: 资本主义与民族主义的关系主要以后者对前者的效应来探索，但它也涉及等式的另一边：矛盾的资本主义力量对民族形成的效应。民族被写入社会空间这一事实，把民族形成锚定在历史与社会过程之中。我偏好使用“民族形成”（nation formation）而非“民族”，因为形成指涉及制度化与实践的历史过程。关于民族或民族主义同质化效应的讨论中令人不安的是：这种预设效应掩盖了细致历史分析的缺席。它使民族被视为漂浮能指，其功能被期望带来预期效应。一旦体现于法律与政策，民族成员身份及其他民族主义方案的制度化就被认为或多或少能实现投射的功能。然而资本主义与民族主义的共时接合要求同时关注资本的普遍逻辑及其历史接合——后者由特定民族主义话语、权力机制与事件中介。它也表明，这一过程一直在变化：资本主义与民族主义在塑造社会关系时逐渐形成了彼此冲突的作用，尽管民族主义投射一个已完成过程的形象。
en: Whereas the relation between capitalism and nationalism has been explored mainly in terms of the effect of the latter on the former, it also involves the other side of the equation: the effects of contradictory capitalist forces on nation formation. The fact that the nation is inscribed in social space anchors nation formation in a historical and social process. I prefer to use the term nation formation rather than nation, since formation denotes a historical process that involves institutionalization and practices. What is troubling in discussions of the homogenizing effects of the nation or nationalism is that this presumed effect masks the absence of careful historical analysis. This enables the nation to be regarded as a floating signifier whose function is expected to bring about the intended effect. Once it is embodied in laws and policies, the institutionalization of national membership and other nationalist programs is supposed to more or less fulfill the projected function. However, the coeval articulation of capitalism and nationalism warrants attention to both the universal logic of capital and its historical articulation, mediated by specific nationalist discourses, mechanisms of power, and events. It also points to dynamic processes in which capitalism and nationalism develop their contentious roles in shaping social relations, even though nationalism projects an image of a completed process.

zh: 民族形成也表达它嵌入社会实践之中——这些实践同时被民族主义话语与制度规制、又颠覆它们。当民族奠基自身于社会关系时，它在日常生活中作为一组具体社会实践被实现。民族的意义是在特定的社会关系商品化过程中被赋予的，也是在这一过程中受到争夺的。尽管民族是想象的观念，一旦被社会与国家行动者召唤，它就作为法律与政策被制度化。
en: Nation formation also expresses its embeddedness in social practices that are simultaneously regulated by and subvert nationalist discourses and institutions. As the nation grounds itself in social relations, it is actualized as a set of concrete social practices in everyday life. The nation is a thing whose meaning is consigned and contested within a specific process of commodification of social relations. Although the nation is an imagined idea, it is institutionalized as laws and policies once it is invoked by social and state actors.

zh: 然而社会制度分析并不充分。民族成员身份的制度化体现政策制定者与民众力量的意图。因此民族形成也需要在社会空间中考察——在那里日常活动发展出对制度的回应并力争修改它们。日常生活的社会实践展示人们在特定历史条件下如何应对资本主义经济原则以及民族话语对资本主义动力的表述。
en: Analysis of social institutions is not sufficient, however. The institutionalization of national membership embodies the intentions of policymakers and popular forces. Thus, nation formation also needs to be examined in the social space, where everyday activities develop responses to institutions and struggle to modify them. Social practices in everyday life demonstrate the historically specific ways in which people negotiate capitalist economic principles and national representations of capitalist dynamics.

zh: 社会是一个全球性问题式。把民族置于社会过程中理解，可看出它变动不居的时间性。全球资本主义的经济原则与民族主义力量在社会生活中诡异地共存。民族主义力量塑造实践，却不能完全同化资本主义动力，使组织社会关系的力量充满矛盾。因此社会内在不稳定。社会的不可能性不能化约为人民文化身份的多样性——按后结构主义路径，这些身份源于社会体内群体的话语斗争。
社会之所以不可能，还因为个人在日常生活中遭遇全球资本主义与民族主义力量的矛盾。正是在他们的社会实践中，我们才能追踪个人颠覆、修改法律与社会制度并赋予其意义的争议性过程。社会实践带着民族与资本主义力量未实现的欲望的印记。社会的不可能性意味着民族形成永不完成。由于民族被写入未定的社会实践，社会制度内部的资本主义力量威胁民族的实现。
en: The social is a global problematic. Ascribing the nation to the social process exposes its fleeting temporality. Economic principles of global capitalism and nationalist forces uncannily coexist in social life. Nationalist forces shape practices but cannot assimilate capitalist dynamics completely, rendering forces that organize social relations contradictory. The social is therefore inherently unstable. The impossibility of determining the social is not reducible to the multitude of cultural identities of people that, according to the poststructuralist approach, arise from discursive struggles of groups within a society.

The social is impossible also because individuals encounter the contradiction of global capitalist and nationalist forces in their everyday lives. It is in their social practices that we can follow the contentious process through which individuals subvert, modify, and assign meanings to laws and social institutions. Social practices are marked with unfulfilled desires of national and capitalist forces. The impossibility of the social implies that nation formation is never complete. As the nation is inscribed in unsettled social practices, capitalist forces within social institutions threaten the nation’s actualization.

zh: 民族与资本主义的内在关系把霸权与主体性奠基在具体的历史与物质形式之中。民族主义对生产与流通的建构赋予资本主义关系以霸权——它使个人能够想象获得对自己劳动之主权的替代方式。创造个人实现其主权的主观意志，是民族为资本主义承担的历史功能之一。作为想象中的大众意识或文化身份，民族并不只是把不平等社会关系转置为民族共同体中的水平关系。它也不只是补偿或置换个人在资本主义关系中对劳动之主权的缺失。相反，民族是在社会关系之中争取人民的认同。它为个人提供新视野与在工作场所和市场创造其主权的意志。例如，农业共同体主义在二十世纪初的日本帝国提供了新的生产与交换体制及集体主权，作为资本主义关系的替代方案，而其制度却悖论式地促进私有财产制度。这意味着民族—民众霸权并不脱离物质基础，而是涉及重造资本主义社会关系的尝试。
en: The intrinsic relationship between the nation and capitalism grounds hegemony and subjectivity in a concretely historical and material form. The nationalist construction of production and circulation confers hegemony on capitalist relations by enabling individuals to imagine an alternative way of attaining sovereignty over their own labor. The creation of individuals’ subjective will in realizing their sovereignty is one of the nation’s historical functions for capitalism. As an imagined popular consciousness or cultural identity, the nation does not merely transpose unequal social relations onto horizontal relations in a national community. Nor does it simply compensate or displace the absence of individuals’ sovereignty over labor in capitalist relations. Rather, the nation enlists the consent of the people in the social terrain. It provides individuals with a new vision and the will to create their sovereignty in the workplace and the market. Agrarian communitarianism, for instance, supplied new regimes of production and exchange and collective sovereignty as alternatives to capitalist relations in the Japanese empire of the early twentieth century, while its institutions paradoxically promoted a private property system. This means that national-popular hegemony is not separate from material foundations but rather involves an attempt to reinvent capitalist social relations.

zh: 主体也在特定历史情势中被构成。在社会空间中，个人并不获得作为阶级成员或民族主体的单一身份，仿佛他或她从一种空间身份被转置到另一种。相反，主体同时被转变为经济主体与民族主体，服从由资本主义力量及其民族主义表述赋予正当性的社会关系新规则。这些主体性不符合经济与民族主义制度规定的本体论位置。主体在将民族主义对物质关系的新主张付诸实践时获得新的社会意识。他们力求不仅在政治、文化与意识形态领域，而且在自身的物质关系中建立对劳动的主权。
en: Subjects are also constituted in specific historical conjunctures. In social space, an individual does not acquire a singular identity as either a class member or national subject, as if he or she were transposed from one spatial identity to the other. Rather, subjects are transformed simultaneously into economic and national subjects who submit to new rules of social relations, which are authorized by capitalist forces and their national representations. These subjectivities do not fit the ontological positions prescribed by economic and nationalist institutions. Subjects acquire a new social consciousness as they practice new nationalist prescriptions for material relations. They seek to establish sovereignty over their labor not just in political, cultural, and ideological spheres but also in their material relations.

zh: 我的路径与米歇尔·福柯（Michel Foucault）的权力理论交叉，尤其社会空间中的权力分析。无论福柯理论被视为纠正霸权概念还是逃避意识形态问题式，他的权力分析都适合我这里的讨论。
遵循他的洞见，我把权力写入社会空间——在那里个人被规训而非简单被压制。例如我探索各种权力如何组织不同的民族主义生产与流通体制——这些体制迎合移民劳动者的愿望，尤其他们对土地所有权的追求。我不把民族主义视为把人民捆绑在一起的意识形态胶水，而是具体说明权力技术——如共同体主义、私有财产制度与信用制度——权力通过这些技术具体地规训主体。
en: My approach intersects with Michel Foucault’s theory of power, especially the analysis of power in social space. Whether Foucault’s theory is regarded as rectifying the notion of hegemony or as absconding from the problematic of ideology, his analysis of power is apt for my discussion here.

Following his insights, I inscribe power in a social space where individuals are disciplined rather than simply repressed. I explore, for instance, the ways in which various powers organized different nationalist regimes of production and circulation that appealed to the desires of migrant laborers, especially their quest for landownership. Instead of viewing nationalism as an ideological glue that binds people together, I specify techniques of power, such as communalism, the private property system, and the credit system, through which power concretely disciplines subjects.

zh: 我的分析在某些方面也不同于福柯。福柯认为各种权力体系“交织”“关联”或“不可分离”，而我试图具体说明权力关系，尤其涉及民族主义与资本主义网络的那些。
有一次他说，权力“与生产力的发展如此同质，以致构成其一部分”——当生产力指资本主义物质力量时。
当福柯暗示权力网络之间存在相互依赖时，主要说的是这些网络彼此促进的关系。他没有具体说明权力网络关系中可能存在的限制或张力。例如当他说全景敞视监狱（Panopticon）的目的是“加强社会力量——增加生产、发展经济、普及教育、提高公共道德水平；增加并倍增”时，并不清楚这一目标在什么条件下实现、是否遇到抑制它的权力动力。
本书中我考虑民族治理术与资本主义扩张的脱节，关注身处资本主义生产与交换回路之中的人。我通过人们应对多种权力的社会实践考察主体性。这些权力可能彼此扩张，也可能互相绕开。
en: My analysis also differs from Foucault’s in some respects. While Foucault believes that various power systems are “interwoven,” “correlated,” or “inseparable,” I attempt to specify the relations of power, especially those involving nationalist and capitalist networks.

On one occasion, he states that power is so “consubstantial with the development of forces of production that it forms part of them” when the forces of production are meant to be capitalist material forces.

When Foucault suggests that there is mutual dependency among networks of power, this is primarily in reference to positive relations. He does not specify the caveats or tensions that might be present in the relations of networks of power. For example, when he states that the aim of the Panopticon is “to strengthen the social forces—to increase production, to develop the economy, spread education, raise the level of public morality; to increase and multiply,” it is not clear under what conditions this objective is realized and whether it encounters power dynamics that inhibit it.

In this book, I consider the disjuncture of national governmentality and capitalist expansion, addressing the people inside the circuits of capitalist production and exchange. I investigate the subjectivity in social practices through which people respond to multiple forces of power that might not only propagate but also circumvent each other.

zh: 满洲
en: manchuria

zh: 鉴于迄今提出的分析框架，我现在描绘两个历史时刻——1931 年日本占领之前与之后——满洲的社会变迁。我把私有财产制度的形成呈现为殖民主义、民族主义与资本主义接合的升华。私有财产制度是把人民与生产资料分离的首要机制，这一过程称为原始积累。原始积累不是纯粹的经济形式；它依赖民族国家的存在，以把私有财产制度作为法律强加。私有财产权的合法化掩盖了财产所有者攫取沉积于土地之上的劳动力的意识形态与物质过程。私有财产制度确立了攫取剩余劳动的权利。它的作用超出资产交易，还涉及对工资和社会必要劳动时间的规制。卡尔·马克思在一个把私有财产制度设定为民族国家本体论基础的讨论中考虑民族国家角色的重要性：与其说国家权力只是保障财产法，不如说国家自身的存在逐渐更依赖这些法律。
马克思对原始积累的论述更多是资本主义的谱系学，而非历史过程的阐述。按许多批评家的说法，原始积累并未在资本主义发展的初始时刻完成，而是以不同形式持续——包括帝国与后工业条件下人民与物质及非物质生产资料的双重分离。
en: In light of the analytical framework presented so far, I now map out the social transformation of Manchuria at two historical moments: before and after the Japanese occupation of 1931. I present the formation of the private property system as a sublimation of the articulation of colonialism, nationalism, and capitalism. The private property system is the primary mechanism that separates people from the means of production, a process called primitive accumulation. Primitive accumulation is not a pure economic form; it depends on the existence of a nation-state to impose the private property system as law. The legalization of private property rights obscures the ideological and material process through which a property owner appropriates labor power deposited on land. As the right to appropriate surplus labor, the private property system is not restricted to the transaction of property assets but involves the regulation of wages and socially necessary times of labor. Karl Marx considers the importance of the role of the nation-state in a discussion that postulates the private property system as the ontological foundation of the nation-state: the state’s existence came to rely on property laws to a greater extent than its power simply safeguards the law.

Karl Marx’s account of primitive accumulation is more a genealogy of capitalism than an exposition of a historical process. According to many critics, primitive accumulation was not completed in the initial moment of capitalist development but continues in different forms, including the separation of people from both the material and nonmaterial means of production under imperial and postindustrial conditions.

zh: 满洲经验展示了民族形成扮演关键角色的原始积累历史过程。马克思的资本积累论述把民族与私有财产制度呈现为资本的要求，然而私有财产权的社会实践在满洲从未固定。尽管民族使财产制度显得自然，私有财产制度仍持续是民族精英、殖民权力持有者与劳动者之间争议的主要来源。满洲私有财产制度的形成以法律、政策与社会实践之间的一系列脱节为标志：国家的私有财产政策偏离法律，社会实践偏离法律与政策。后一种偏离标志着民族形成与全球资本主义之间的张力——二者共同构成生产与交换的社会关系。
en: The Manchurian experience demonstrates historical processes of primitive accumulation in which nation formation played a key role. Marx’s accounts of capital accumulation present the nation and the private property system as requirements of capital, yet the social practices of private property rights were never fixed in Manchuria. Although the nation made the property system seem natural, the private property system continued to be a main source of dispute among national elites, colonial power holders, and laborers. The formation of the private property system in Manchuria was marked by a series of disjunctures among law, policies, and social practices: state policies of the private property system deviated from the laws, and social practices deviated from laws and policies. The subsequent deviation signifies the tension between nation formation and global capitalism, which together constituted the social relations of production and exchange.

zh: 1884 年中国清中央政府把移居满洲合法化——此地先前作为清朝创立者的发祥地而被保留——土地逐渐私有化，被缺乏政府财源与私人进项的地方官员出售给华北移民。土地成为商品，其买卖不受限制——尽管贿赂官员能使购买者获得比正常途径更大的地块。由于行政权力不足，政府没有完全建立私有财产的法律保护。相反，财产所有者、尤其大地主依赖私人军队保护土地。此外，耕种私有土地的劳动力短缺以及未耕土地的可得性，吸引来自华北与朝鲜的农民移民——他们成为农业生产的主力。在经济私有化的这一初始阶段，自耕农更多从事自给性农业而非商业性农业。作物商业化中地主与商人的关系尚未成熟。
en: When the central Qing government of China legalized migration to Manchuria in 1884, a place previously preserved as the birthplace of the founder of the Qing, land gradually was privatized and sold to migrants from North China by local officials, who lacked government revenue and private income. Land became a commodity, whose sale and purchase were unrestricted, even though bribery of officials enabled purchasers to acquire larger parcels than could otherwise be obtained. Due to its lack of administrative power, the government did not fully establish legal protections for private property. Instead, property owners, especially large landlords, relied on private armies to protect their land. In addition, the shortage of labor to cultivate privately owned land as well as the availability of uncultivated land attracted peasant migrants from North China and Korea, who came to be the mainstay of agricultural production. In this initial stage of economic privatization, independent farmers tended to engage less in commercial than subsistence farming. The relationship between landlords and merchants in the commercialization of crops had not yet matured.

zh: 始于十九世纪末的日本殖民权力与资本的逐渐侵蚀，对满洲社会关系产生悖论式影响。它加速满洲纳入全球资本主义网络，但也引发中国政府（中央与地方）对财产与生产关系的干预。通过土地的领土化与私有化的相互作用，商业农业与满洲内外农产品的流通迅速发展。到 1930 年代初，满洲生产的大豆几乎占世界贸易大豆的一半。中国政府干预社会关系，把自身塑造成能够保卫满洲与中国本部免受日本殖民的民族政权。
en: The gradual encroachment of Japanese colonial power and capital that began in the late nineteenth century had a paradoxical impact on social relations in Manchuria. It accelerated the incorporation of Manchuria into the global capitalist network, but it also provoked the intervention of the Chinese government (central and local) in relations of property and production. Through the interplay of the nationalization and privatization of land, commercial farming and the circulation of agricultural produce within and beyond Manchuria swiftly developed. By the early 1930s, Manchuria was producing almost half of all the soybeans traded in the world. The Chinese government intervened in social relations, representing itself as a national regime that could defend Manchuria and China proper from Japanese colonization.

zh: 本书考察满洲纳入全球生产与市场交换链条的两个时刻：十九世纪末至 1931 年；以及 1932 至 1945 年的满洲国时代。第一时期满洲经历一种浓缩的积累形式：原始积累与出口导向农业生产共存。当荒地被变为具有市场价值的耕地时，土地成为地主、商人、国家与日本商业利益投资的首要资本形式。通过各种中国民族主义权力与日本资本的协商，满洲土地与劳动的关系被纳入全球市场到如此程度，以致世界性萧条加上军阀政权持续战争，在 1920 年代末酿成社会危机。1932 年起的事实殖民标志另一时刻：它加剧满洲纳入新配置的全球资本积累链条。基于地租制度的社会关系被转变为基于信用制度的社会关系，改变了社会不平等赖以形成的主轴。
en: This book investigates two moments in the incorporation of Manchuria into a global chain of production and market exchange: the period from the late nineteenth century to 1931; and the Manchukuo era, which lasted from 1932 to 1945. During the first period, Manchuria experienced a condensed form of accumulation in which primitive accumulation coexisted with export-oriented agricultural production. At the moment when wasteland was turned into arable land with market value, land became a primary form of capital in which landlords, merchants, the state, and Japanese business interests invested. Through the negotiation of various Chinese nationalist powers and Japanese capital, the relationship between land and labor in Manchuria was incorporated into the global market to such an extent that the worldwide depression, combined with the ongoing warfare of the warlord regime, precipitated a social crisis in the late 1920s. De facto colonization from 1932 marked a different moment, as it intensified the incorporation of Manchuria into a newly configured chain of global capital accumulation. Social relations based on the ground rent system were transformed into those based on the credit system, modifying the axis of social inequality.

zh: 以下各页我追踪：在满洲资本转变的两个时刻中，社会的双重抽象如何催生族群、民族、地区与时间的不平衡。在这些意图建立民族国家的政权所塑造的形象中（无论是中国军阀政权、满洲国，还是共产主义者力求建立的新民族国家），土地日益不仅意味着谋生或市场交换的资源，而且意味着民族的领土。把土地纳入民族国家的领土框架，为土地设定独立于供求法则的人为价格：1931 年前的中国民族主义政府设定契约条款，把土地交换限制于其国民，并对非国民（未入籍为中国国民的朝鲜人）可被雇用的最多年限与可付最高工资施加限制。1932 年建立的满洲国设想把自耕农——而非商人与富农——确立为民族的堡垒。这种将社会关系纳入民族国家框架的做法以暴力推进：政府以叛国罪指控违反者并监禁他们。人民对自己身体、劳动与产品的主权被国家攫取——国家与其同商人、地主的联盟一起，成为民族主义与资本主义的主要推动者。
en: In the following pages, I pursue the ways in which, during both moments of capital transformation in Manchuria, the double abstraction of the social gave birth to ethnic, national, regional, and temporal unevenness. In the representation of a would-be national state (whether it was a Chinese warlord regime, Manchukuo, or the new national state that the communists sought to create), land increasingly meant not just a resource for subsistence living or market exchange but the territory of the nation. Nationalization set an artificial price on land independent of the law of supply and demand: the nationalist government of China until 1931 set the terms of contracts, restricting the exchange of land to its nationals and imposing limits on the maximum number of years nonnationals (Koreans who had not been naturalized as Chinese nationals) could be employed and maximum wages they could be paid. The Manchukuo state, established in 1932, envisaged the establishment of small farmers, rather than merchants and rich farmers, as the bastion of the nation. This nationalization of social relations proceeded violently, as the government charged violators with treason and imprisoned them. The sovereignty of people over their bodies, labor, and products was appropriated by the state, which emerged with its alliance with merchants and landlords as a major agent of nationalism and capitalism.

zh: 按国民资格设定的地价对经济发展产生矛盾效应。一方面它是资本积累的障碍，因为它抑制土地与劳动商品的自由流通。另一方面它是创造与土地分离的“自由”劳动并提高地租的机制。按国民资格设定的地价一举克服了两种“反资本主义的痼疾”——即马克思在分析殖民政府给未经开垦的土地设定人为价格的作用时所描述的大片可得土地与劳动力短缺。

把土地纳入领土框架后，高昂的地价迫使劳动者长期受雇劳动，尽管购买自己土地的前景渺茫。按国民资格人为设定的地价，影响工人是成为土地所有者，还是成为没有土地的自由劳动者。1931 年前满洲的民族形成使华北移民能够成为土地所有者，同时阻止同为移民的朝鲜人这样做。当日本开始侵蚀满洲时，资助朝鲜移民、派遣警察与军队保护他们等干预，消除了朝鲜人先前拥有的在满洲居住与置产的习惯权利。朝鲜人的民族成员身份与财产权走到日本殖民权力与中国民族主义政府在满洲协商的中心舞台。
en: The national price set on land had contradictory effects on economic development. On the one hand, it was a barrier to capital accumulation since it inhibited the free circulation of the commodities of land and labor. On the other hand, it was a mechanism that created “free” labor separated from land and it increased rent. The national price killed the two birds of “anticapitalist cancer”—a vast area of available land and a shortage of labor that Marx described in his analysis of the role of the colonial government in setting an artificial price on virgin soil.

By setting an exorbitant price, the nationalization of land compelled laborers to work for a long time despite the poor prospects of buying land of one’s own. The artificial national price intervened in the process through which workers became landowners or landless free labor. Nation formation in Manchuria until 1931 enabled migrants from North China to become landowners while preventing their Korean counterparts from doing so. As Japan began to encroach on Manchuria, interventions such as funding Korean migrants and sending police and armies to protect them eliminated the customary rights to reside and own property in Manchuria that Koreans had previously possessed. Koreans’ national membership and property rights came to occupy center stage in the negotiations between the Japanese colonial power and the Chinese nationalist government in Manchuria.

zh: 财产关系的族群/民族轴是人民、土地及其关系双重抽象的历史形式：一方面作为民族的体现，另一方面作为商品。民族成员身份的建构与个人劳动力在农业生产中的价值不可分离——日中双方权力都试图攫取它。因此民族成员身份的建构以当权者与国民的关系为前提——这些国民作为耕作者与雇佣劳动者已建立与土地的关系。把居民变成劳动力又以当权者同劳动者的关系为前提——后者的民族身份圈定了其土地所有权与就业机会。
en: The ethnic/national axes of property relations were a historical form of the double abstraction of people, land, and their relations as the embodiment of the nation on the one hand and as a commodity on the other. The construction of national membership was inseparable from the value of one’s labor power in agricultural production, which both the Japanese and Chinese powers tried to appropriate. For this reason, the construction of national membership was predicated on their relationship with nationals, who, as cultivators and wage laborers, had established relations with land. The production of people as labor was in turn predicated on their relationship with laborers, whose national identities circumscribed their chances for landownership and employment.

zh: 我对人民、土地及其关系交织抽象的讨论集中于两方面：国民与非国民之间的界线的持续建构——它被写入涉及土地交换的关系；以及同时塑造又动摇民族边界与生产交换社会实践的力量。生产人民与土地交织抽象的力量是日本殖民主义、中国民族主义与资本主义的相互作用。日本殖民权力与中国民族主义权力都不是单一统一实体。二者内部都充满张力与冲突。尽管日本帝国把自己描绘为天衣无缝，事实上它由代表不同国民、彼此争斗的不同行政单位（如朝鲜总督府、满洲国、关东军）组成。1931 年前满洲的中国民族权力由军政府、文官官僚与商人推进。日中势力各自内部及双方之间的关系，决定了如何区分国民与非国民，以及这两类人的社会关系。尽管日中权力争夺满洲领土主权，它们共享农业资本主义发展之梦。正是在日中权力缠结的关系中，朝鲜人（与中国人）找到间隙空间，力求与双方协商。
en: My discussion of the entwined abstraction of people, land, and their relations centers on two aspects: the ongoing construction of boundaries between national and nonnational members, which were inscribed in the relationship involving the exchange of land; and the forces that simultaneously shaped and destabilized national boundaries and social practices of production and exchange. The force that produced the entwined abstraction of people and land was the interplay of Japanese colonialism, Chinese nationalism, and capitalism. Neither the Japanese colonial power nor the Chinese nationalist power was a single, unified entity. Both were fraught with tensions and conflicts within themselves. Although the Japanese empire portrayed itself as seamless, in fact it consisted of distinct administrative units (e.g., Government General of Korea, the Manchukuo state, and the Kwantung Army) that represented different nationals and feuded with one another. The Chinese national power in Manchuria until 1931 was advanced by the military government, civil bureaucrats, and merchants. The relationship within and between the Japanese and Chinese powers determined the boundaries of the national and the nonnational, as well as their social relations. Although the Japanese and Chinese powers competed for territorial sovereignty in Manchuria, they shared dreams of the capitalist development of agriculture. It was within the entangled relationship between the Japanese and Chinese powers that Koreans (and Chinese) found an interstitial space where they sought to negotiate with both.

zh: 第一章把朝鲜移民呈现为日本帝国形成及其资本主义扩张的机制——我称之为领土与资本主义的“渗透”政治。我先解读韩国民族主义文学的一部代表性小说《北间岛》（Pukkando），由此引出渗透政治与农民对自身劳动的主权。
en: Chapter 1 presents Korean migration as a mechanism in the formation of the Japanese empire and its capitalist expansion, which I term the territorial and capitalist politics of “osmosis.” Setting the stage for this is my reading of Pukkando, a representative novel in the South Korean nationalist literature; the analysis foregrounds the politics of osmosis and the peasants’ sovereignty over their labor.

zh: 第二至五章考察日本殖民满洲两阶段——领土侵蚀（1910 年代–1931）与事实殖民（1932–45）——中民族形成与资本主义扩张之间的张力。每一时期的民族形成都以历史特定特征为标志，例如中国国家权力、日本殖民权力与朝鲜农民之间独特的三角关系，以及 1931 年前对移民与土地财产的民族主义表象、1931 年后的农业共同体主义等民族文化话语。两时期不同的民族主义政治与文化在国民与非国民之间划出不同区分，并以各种方式组织生产与市场交换的社会关系。在我描绘每一时期民族形成的历史特殊性的同时，我也聚焦民族形成与资本主义扩张令人困惑的关系。二者内在张力在民族成员身份与财产权的法律、政策与社会实践之间持续鸿沟中找到历史表达。尽管作为事实殖民地的满洲国被认为官僚化、现代而理性，民族形成过程却与其前“军阀”政权下一样不完整。
en: Chapters 2–5 examine the tensions between nation formation and capitalist expansion in the two phases of Japanese colonization of Manchuria— territorial encroachment (1910s–1931) and de facto colonization (1932–45). Nation formation in each period was marked by historically specific characteristics, for example, the distinctive triangular relationship among the Chinese national power, the Japanese colonial power, and Korean peasants, and such cultural discourses of the nation as the nationalist representation of migrants and landed property until 1931 and agrarian communitarianism after 1931. The disparate nationalist politics and culture in the two periods drew different distinctions between nationals and nonnationals and organized social relations of production and market exchange in various ways. While I delineate the historical specificities of nation formation in each period, I also focus on the perplexing relations of nation formation and capitalist expansion. The intrinsic tension between them finds its historical expression in the persistent gulfs among the laws, policies, and social practices of national membership and property rights. Although as a de facto colony Manchukuo was thought of as bureaucratic, modern, and rational, the process of nation formation was as incomplete as it had been under the preceding “warlord” regime.

zh: 第二、三章比较 1931 年前民族政权的地区差异。尽管同属张作霖为首的区域管辖，奉天与间岛政府通过不同政策与社会实践把民族成员身份原则付诸实践。民族成员身份原则把土地私有视为国民（gongmin，公民）的首要权利。政权承诺国民有权选举政治代表，但这一权利始终未能行使。在南满与东满地区，民族与殖民权力对领土主权的竞争被转化为对朝鲜人权利的争夺——日本与张政府都把朝鲜人视为日本帝国主义的先锋。南满的奉天政府对朝鲜人采取排斥政策，禁止他们取得中国国籍与拥有土地。相反，东满的间岛政府采取包容政策，鼓励朝鲜人入籍为中国国民。对朝鲜人的不同政策源于张作霖政府与日本之间不同的关系——南满是一种争夺而平衡的关系，东部是一种竞争关系。
en: Chapters 2 and 3 compare regional variations in the national regime until 1931. Although they belonged to the same regional jurisdiction, headed by Zhang Zuolin, the Fengtian and Kando governments put the principle of national membership into practice through disparate policies and social practices. The principle of national membership considered private ownership of land to be the foremost right of nationals (gongmin). The right to elect political representatives was promised to nationals but never implemented. In the regions of South and East Manchuria, competition between the national and colonial powers for territorial sovereignty was translated into contestation over the rights of Koreans, whom both Japan and the Zhang government considered to be the vanguard of Japanese imperialism. The Fengtian government of South Manchuria adopted an exclusionary policy toward Koreans, prohibiting them from acquiring Chinese citizenship and owning land. In contrast, the Kando government in East Manchuria adopted an inclusive policy, encouraging Koreans to become naturalized as Chinese nationals. The disparate policies toward Koreans arose from the different relationships between the Zhang Zuolin government and Japan—a contending yet balanced one in South Manchuria and a competing one in the east.

zh: 第二、三章也比较从民族主义政策退却的模式。无论排斥还是包容，两地区朝鲜人口都膨胀，其中大多数仍未入籍。张政府与朝鲜人的协商采取多种形式。政府因应局势临时采取各种措施，要求朝鲜村落的少数代表或户主采纳满族习俗。这些文化的、共同体的民族成员身份随时间被法律的、以个人为基础的形式取代——后者要求所有十八岁以上男性成年人向县署申请许可。朝鲜人以变异的民族成员身份与土地所有权形式颠覆此类法律与政策：南满长期租地（sangjogwŏn，商租权），间岛以少数已入籍朝鲜人或中国人之名登记所购土地（Chŏnminje，佃民制）。未入籍朝鲜人也以短期佃农与低工资劳动者身份谋生，频繁移往边缘地带以规避定居的法律限制。
en: The patterns of retreat from nationalist policies are also compared in chapters 2 and 3. Whether exclusionary or inclusive, the Korean population swelled in both regions, where most remained unnaturalized. Negotiations between the Zhang government and Koreans took many forms. The government improvised various measures requiring a few representatives of a Korean village or the heads of households to adopt Manchu customs. These cultural and communal national memberships were replaced over time with a legal and individually based form that required all male adults above the age of eighteen to apply for authorization at county offices. Koreans subverted such laws and policies by adopting aberrant forms of national membership and landownership: leasing land for long periods (sangjogwŏn) in South Manchuria and registering purchased land under the names of the few naturalized Koreans or Chinese (Chŏnminje) in Kando. Unnaturalized Koreans also survived by working as short-term tenants and low-wage laborers, frequently migrating to the periphery to evade the legal restrictions on settlement.

zh: 这些颠覆性的社会实践得到容忍，表明朝鲜人的议价能力源于他们的水稻种植技术——张政府与日本都认为这项技术有价值。民族成员身份从文化的、共同体的形式转变为法律的、个人的形式，加之法律实践与习惯实践并存，表明国民与非国民之间的区分是模糊的，进而表明（中国）民族在满洲的形成并不完整。其法律、政策与社会实践的过渡性质，让人联想到一幅前现代乃至封建的满洲图景。但我把这种转瞬即逝的不稳定与不规则，置于民族形成与资本主义扩张的现代困境之中。
en: The fact that these seditious social practices were tolerated suggests that Koreans’ bargaining power stemmed from their skill at rice farming, which both the Zhang government and Japan found valuable. The transformation of national membership from cultural and collective to legal and individual and the coexistence of legal and customary practices indicate the blurred distinction between nationals and nonnationals and, by extension, the incomplete formation of the (Chinese) nation in Manchuria. The transitory nature of its laws, policies, and social practices suggests a premodern, if not feudal, image of Manchuria. But I situate the fleeting instability and irregularity in the modern conundrum of nation formation and capitalist expansion.

zh: 第四、五章探讨农业合作社——一种与土地所有权交织在一起的民族成员身份的新历史形式。在其中，朝鲜人与日本人不仅被接受为满洲的合法居民，而且在原则上得以成为小土地所有者。双重国籍同样是满洲国民族形成的特征。日本帝国在所谓的民族国家之间实行分工，朝鲜总督府与关东军继续分别代表在满朝鲜人与日本人，而这些人同时又受满洲国统治。各行政权力分别为朝鲜人、日本人或中国人建立了不同的农业合作社。第四章讨论殖民者的领土与资本主义欲望，正是这种欲望促使各行政权力采纳农业共同体主义，作为重塑社会关系、把满洲整合进帝国的手段。农业合作社在分配给不同国民的土地与贷款份额上助长了不平等，这违背了民族成员身份的多元主义原则与普遍私有财产权。我把这种等级模式归因于不同国民在日本帝国中的不平等地位，以及他们对满洲乃至整个帝国资本主义发展的不同贡献。
en: Chapters 4 and 5 explore agrarian cooperatives as a new historical form of national membership entwined with landownership in which Koreans and Japanese were not only accepted as legal residents in Manchuria but also in principle elevated to small property owners. Dual nationality also characterized nation formation in the Manchukuo state. As the Japanese empire practiced division of labor among putative nation-states, the Government General of Korea and the Kwantung Army continued to represent, respectively, Koreans and Japanese in Manchuria who were also simultaneously governed by the Manchukuo state. Each administrative power built different agrarian cooperatives for Koreans, Japanese, or Chinese. Chapter 4 discusses the colonizer’s territorial and capitalist desires, which prompted the various administrative powers to adopt agrarian communitarianism as a means of reinventing social relations and integrating Manchuria into the empire. Agrarian cooperatives fostered inequality in terms of the share of land and loans distributed to different nationals, which defied the pluralistic principle of national membership and universal private property rights. I attribute the hierarchical pattern to the unequal positions of different nationals in the Japanese empire and their dissimilar contributions to capitalist development in Manchuria and the empire as a whole.

zh: 第五章考察治理术的形成，它暴露了民族形成与资本主义扩张之间裂隙的另一层面。农业合作社制度构成了一种新的治理术。合作社把治理纳入民族国家的框架，同时把按出身、社会经济地位与国籍划分的人口同质化，并创造了规训技术。但资本主义动力同时阻碍了这类民族主义制度的实现，不断造成朝鲜与中国农民的分化及其与土地的分离。尽管调整措施层出不穷，各行政权力仍无法将朝鲜人的身体移动标准化。对朝鲜人进行标记、编码与登记的实践收效甚微，因为它们涉及的朝鲜移民尚不足总数的一半。
en: Chapter 5 examines the formation of governmentality, which exposed a different layer of the schism between nation formation and capitalist expansion. The institution of agrarian cooperatives constituted a new governmentality. The cooperatives nationalized governance, while homogenizing a population divided by origin, socioeconomic status, and nationality, and created disciplinary techniques. But capitalist dynamics simultaneously thwarted the actualization of such nationalist institutions, engendering continuous differentiation and displacement of Korean and Chinese peasants from the land. Despite a plethora of adjustments, the administrative powers were incapable of standardizing the corporeal movement of Koreans. The practices of marking, coding, and registering Koreans had meager results, as they involved less than half the total number of Korean migrants.

zh: 本书主体部分为第六章确立满洲与朝鲜（及中国）共产主义政治之间的联系提供了基础。
en: The main body of this book provides a basis for establishing the link between Manchuria and Korean (and Chinese) communist politics in chapter 6.

zh: 关于北朝鲜革命起源的讨论，历来聚焦于殖民时期已故金日成及其战友在满洲领导的传奇反殖民斗争。我则探讨朝鲜共产主义运动的社会起源，以及共产主义者所持的民族主义如何妨碍他们认识满洲的社会关系、削弱他们自称秉持国际主义的说法。殖民主权嵌入民族主体的创造之中，这些主体的劳动力与财产权决定了民族成员身份。任何共产主义批判的可行性，都取决于消除殖民资本主义所催生的社会关系。但朝鲜与中国的共产主义者都把满洲视为各自所谓民族国家的延伸。他们无法理解朝鲜、中国本部与满洲社会关系的共性与历史特殊性，因而未能在这些地方之间建立国际联盟。从中国共产党中清洗朝鲜人所造成的创伤，暴露了民族主义与国际主义之间的张力。满洲的共产主义斗争预示了北朝鲜国家的建立——这个国家将更偏向民族主义而非国际主义。
en: Discussions of the origins of the North Korean revolution have always been preoccupied with the legendary anticolonial struggle in Manchuria led by the late Kim Il Sung and his comrades during the colonial period. Instead I explore the social origins of the Korean communist movement and the ways in which the nationalism espoused by the communists impeded their recognition of social relations in Manchuria and undermined their claims to internationalism. Colonial sovereignty was embedded in the creation of national subjects, whose labor power and property rights determined national membership. The viability of any communist critique depended on the elimination of social relations spawned by colonial capitalism. But both Korean and Chinese communists regarded Manchuria as an extension of their putative nation-states. Their inability to comprehend the commonalities and historical specificities of social relations in Korea, China proper, and Manchuria prevented them from creating international alliances across these places. The trauma of the purge of Koreans from the Chinese Communist Party exposed the tension between nationalism and internationalism. The communist struggle in Manchuria prefigured the establishment of the North Korean state that would be more nationalist than internationalist.

en: Ibid., 104–15; Nicos Poulantzas, Classes in Contemporary Capitalism (London: Verso, 1975), 70–84. Poulantzas does not fully overcome the critique that because the nation is removed from social relations of production and circulation national consciousness engenders an illusion or fictional subjectivity. Even though he situates the nation in social relations, he is preoccupied with the integrating function that the nation is expected to perform. There is a fundamental tension within Poulantzas’s framework between an attempt to situate the nation in a social formation and the conceptualization of social relations and the nation as separately given and fixed. It is not clear whether ideology simply unifies fractured and segmented relations among people so that they will perform the tasks of the division of labor as a unit, whether ideology articulates with material practices to constitute new social relations and subjectivity, or whether the nation transforms itself as a result of its articulation with social relations. The tension between the nationalization of frontiers and the transnational expansion of capital also needs to be examined.
